//: trailingSlash keeps a folder URL a folder. Without it Vercel serves
/randomize-studio/intro (no slash), and a browser reads that last segment
as a FILE - so every relative URL on the page resolves one directory too
becomes /css/panel.css, and the page loads nothing. With it, that URL
redirects to /randomize-studio/intro/ and relative paths mean what they
say. Every page here is an index.html in a folder of its own, so this is
the right shape for all of them.
The redirects are from the rename of font-experiments to randomize-studio,
so old links and bookmarks still land.
